matching_rule: A provided Overture POI is included for a component if its categories.primary or any categories.alternate value is in that component's exact set; count the POI at most once per component.
v2_contract: Estimator-v2 code must load selected_sets from this file; do not duplicate category strings or infer replacements from leaderboard scores.

exclusions.hospitals: Excluded per organizer method: Overture hospital categories exceed the removed reference count and are not a facilities component.
exclusions.ems: emergency_medicine and emergency_room describe emergency clinical care, not ambulance/EMS stations; emergency roadside services are also not stations.
exclusions.schools: Exclude dance, driving, music, cosmetology, flight, specialty/vocational, sports, and other commercial/activity schools; exclude day_care_preschool absent evidence it is part of the organizer's school reference definition.

sensitivity_variants.fire_all_fire_or_rescue_categories: Diagnostic only; the regex also captures firework retail, fire/water restoration, firearm training, fireplace service, firewood, and animal rescue, so it is not a defensible station set.
sensitivity_variants.ems_plus_emergency_medicine: Diagnostic only; measures the zero-tract change if the emergency_medicine category is added.
sensitivity_variants.schools_plus_day_care_preschool: Diagnostic only; measures the zero-tract change if day_care_preschool is counted.
sensitivity_variants.schools_all_school_or_education_categori: Diagnostic only; intentionally broad regex includes specialty, commercial, administrative, and activity categories.

provenance: Sets are the existing estimator-v0 category contract retained after the 2026-10-24 provided-data category/source/confidence/name audit. No leaderboard information, hidden target, removed reference layer, or external facility list was used to choose them.
